name: R040-clefable-taunt-mirror-coat-replacement
why: Challenge 7. Same plan as R035: Clefable (389) Metronome calls Taunt on the player's Snorlax (826) and Hyper Beam knocks it out in that turn; the replacement Milotic (559: Surf, Ice Beam, Safeguard, Mirror Coat; no Counter) is scored on the next turn and the Mirror Coat viability takes the extra random +1 while the target is taunted (runCvMirrorCoat).
